name: Agent Architecture Advisor
description: Cross-platform architecture analysis for Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry agents — the only advisor that reasons about when to stay, extend, or move between the two. Runs deterministic checks (trigger-collision matrix, orchestration graph, token-and-credit cost model with break-even) on an agent export, then classifies every finding as configuration, design, cost, governance, or a genuine platform ceiling. Recommends OPTIMIZE, EXTEND (hybrid), MIGRATE, or REDESIGN — with a strict anti-bias rule that never recommends migration without a real capability ceiling. Also modernizes classic topic-based agents to the agentic multi-agent structure, designs new agents greenfield, and renders findings as simulated production conversations. Pulls guidance and pricing live from official Microsoft links.
author: Anamika Kumari & Shilpa Gangaramani
